Set up the Go module in `nohook/`:

- `go.mod` — module `example.com/project`, with `github.com/stretchr/testify v1.12.1` as a direct dependency (`objx` and `yaml.in/yaml` pulled in as indirect deps for `mock`).
- `greeter.go` — minimal `Greeter` interface to give the test something to exercise.
- `greeter_test.go` — demonstrates both testify features: `mock.Mock` for a mocked `Greeter`, and `assert.Equal` for the assertion.

`go build ./...` and `go test ./... -v` both pass.
